_about: Terminology index: one row per component or property. name = the kaltura-ds name (KEP UI's component name written as words, the same as the preview page section titles); anchor = its section id on index.html. figma = Figma Platform DS (layer and component-set names); kep = KEP UI @kaltura/ds-react-components (React); ds = kaltura-ds classes; was = old kaltura-ds names that still work. Edit this file whenever a component is added, renamed or fixed, then run: python3 tools/build-terminology.py

components.name: Button
components.figma: Buttons > Pill (Type Primary | Secondary | Danger | Translucent), Borderless
components.kep: Button (variant="pill" | "borderless", color primary | secondary | danger | translucent), IconButton
components.notes: Figma "Pill" = KEP variant="pill" = the default filled button here. The grey button is "secondary" in KEP and here.

components.name: Split Button
components.kep: SplitButton (action button, menu toggle button, menu)

components.name: Switch
components.notes: Figma calls the thumb "Handle". State lives in aria-checked; ds.js also sets the old on/off classes.

components.name: Slider
components.figma: Slider (Type Continuous | Discrete; State Default, Hover / Focus, Disabled)
components.kep: Slider (rail, track, thumb, valueLabel, mark, markActive)
components.ds: ds-slider + ds-slider-continuous | ds-slider-discrete, ds-slider-input, ds-slider-value-label, ds-slider-mark, ds-slider-mark-active
components.notes: Built on a native range input. Figma calls the thumb "Picker" and the value label "Label".

components.name: Select
components.figma: Select Menu > Select, Select borderless, Select Menu Item, Seperator
components.notes: KEP's other library (bits) calls it Dropdown.

components.name: Menu
components.figma: Select Menu, Select Menu Item, Seperator
components.ds: ds-menu-wrapper, ds-menu, ds-menu-item, ds-menu-item-start-icon, ds-menu-item-icon, ds-nested-menu-item, ds-nested-menu, ds-menu-divider-item, ds-menu-section-title, ds-menu-section-title-lead
components.notes: Same look as the select menu (ds-select-menu, ds-select-item). KEP MenuItem `icon` is the right icon; KEP bits calls it rightIcon and its leading icon `icon` (ds-menu-item-start-icon here). MenuDividerItem and MenuSectionTitle are in KEP bits.

components.name: Popover
components.notes: Look from KEP: elevated surface, 16px padding, medium elevation (--ds-shadow-menu).

components.name: Date Picker
components.ds: ds-date-picker, ds-date-picker-field, ds-date-picker-open-button, ds-date-picker-input, ds-date-picker-popper, ds-date-picker-error
components.notes: Calendar look from KEP (MUI DateCalendar). Composed = inside ds-composed-input.

components.name: Time Picker
components.ds: ds-time-picker, ds-time-picker-field, ds-time-picker-open-button, ds-time-picker-input, ds-time-picker-popper, ds-time-picker-error
components.notes: Figma shows a clock face; KEP (and here) use hour / minute / AM-PM lists.

components.name: Rich Text
components.ds: ds-rich-text, ds-rich-text-toolbar, ds-rich-text-action, ds-rich-text-editor, ds-rich-text-read-only, ds-rich-text-error
components.notes: Bold, italic, underline, lists, alignment. KEP's image and link actions are not included.

components.name: Segmented Buttons
components.ds: ds-segmented-container, ds-segmented-container-full-width, ds-segmented-button; aria-disabled="true" on the container

components.name: Data Table
components.notes: Skeleton rows: KEP default 3 rows of tone-5 bars.

components.name: Pagination
components.kep: Pagination (variant text | outlined, shape rounded | circular, showFirstButton, showLastButton, siblingCount, boundaryCount)
components.notes: With data-count, ds.js renders the page buttons and ranges.

components.name: Status
components.kep: Status (variant filled | borderless, color default | success | warning | error | primary)
components.ds: ds-status, ds-status-borderless, ds-status-success, ds-status-warning, ds-status-error, ds-status-primary, ds-status-icon
components.notes: Figma Pending = warning, Danger = error. The older ds-table-status (table dot and text) still works.

components.name: Initials
components.notes: KEP bits calls it Avatar. Sizes differ: ds-initials-lg is 48px, KEP size="large" is 96px.

components.name: Toast
components.ds: ds-alert-floating, DS.showToast(); ds.js adds ds-toast-active to the showing toast

components.name: Tooltip
components.kep: Tooltip (placement, enter delay, shows on focus)
components.notes: ds.js flips it when there is no room. ds-tooltip-top|bottom|left|right name the arrow side.

components.name: Modal
components.kep: Modal (variant task | content), ModalTitle (onClose, closeButtonVariant), ModalContent, ModalActions, ModalCloseButton
components.ds: ds-modal, ds-modal-variant-content, ds-modal-title, ds-modal-body, ds-modal-footer, ds-modal-close, ds-modal-close-pill, ds-modal-media
components.notes: Task (the default) is static; content (ds-modal-variant-content) closes on Escape, backdrop click or the X, and scrolls as a whole. KEP ModalContent = ds-modal-body, ModalActions = ds-modal-footer.

components.name: Link
components.notes: Figma Custom Links are icon links without underline; KEP Link is underlined.

components.name: Icon
components.notes: Same icon set; file names are kebab-case here.

properties.name: Sizes
properties.notes: Same words, not always the same pixels: compare px, not names.

properties.name: Yellow-orange accent
properties.notes: Not the grey secondary button. Old name --ds-accent still works.

properties.name: Font
properties.kep: defaultFontFamily: Lato, Helvetica Neue, Segoe UI, sans-serif; loaded from fonts.kaltura.com
properties.notes: Kaltura's font proxy hides the user's IP from Google (GDPR).

properties.name: Field border
properties.figma: Tone 3; Hover Tone 2; Focus Primary; Error Danger; Disable Tone 4 (Text Single Line, Textarea; Checkbox and Radio rest on Tone 3)
properties.kep: tone4 resting, tone3 hover, primary.main focus
properties.notes: KEP UI differs from Figma here: its resting border is one step lighter.

properties.name: Surfaces
properties.notes: Protection (#3D3D3D, both themes) is for text over media. KEP's code calls it possibly added by mistake; Figma defines it.
